{{Infobox player |id=Infest |ids=Jnsane, revolt |name=Joao Quintal |country=Portugal |birth_date={{Birth date and age|1986|07|07}} |clan= |image= |status=Active |spawned=2000 |history= }} Initially wanting to play [[DOOM]], Infest receded to Quakeworld because the current Pentium I 200Mhz wasn't enough to run the former.
He also played some [[Unreal Tournament]] very briefly in the beginning, aswell as some [[Quake3]] which somewhat appealed to him, but eventually the focal point fell onto the faulty bunnyhop of Quakeworld.
Having his glory days between 2005 - 2007, he rose the ranks and claims to be among the 3 best Portuguese players.
Eventually he left as parts of his community jumped ship to [[CS]], aswell as the demoralizing bad ping to EU at the time.
Nowadays playing on a laptop without decent specs mostly for fun. == Achievements == {{Achievement table/intro}} {{Achievement|year=2020|place=9-16|event=DM6 Duel Tournament|additional=Div 2|mode=1on1|flag=|team=|prize=}} {{Achievement|year=2005|place=1|event=Duelmania|additional=Portugal|mode=1on1|flag=|team=|prize=}} {{Achievement table/outro}}
